name: Hemp Milk
siboNotes: Hemp milk is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it contains no FODMAPs and is naturally low in fermentable compounds.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added high-FODMAP sweeteners
Shake well before using as natural separation occurs
Check labels for added inulin or chicory root which are high-FODMAP
Store in refrigerator and use within 7-10 days of opening
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids
Contains complete protein with all essential amino acids
Good source of magnesium and phosphorus
Naturally free from lactose, soy, and nuts
